rules.cause: Pinned core rejects public Trojan without TLS and public VLESS without TLS or other encryption.
rules.strategy: For Trojan, test a separate TLS candidate preserving endpoint/auth/SNI. For VLESS, require server-compatible TLS or encryption settings; JSON wrapping alone does not bypass this requirement.
Test strict certificate verification; never infer or download-and-trust a certificate pin.

rules.cause: Certificate chain not trusted by the calibrated test environment.
rules.strategy: Verify environment CA receipt first; require provider-supplied trust/pin before a repair.

rules.cause: Supplied TLS name does not match verified certificate.
rules.strategy: Require authoritative endpoint/SNI information; do not brute-force names or disable verification.

rules.cause: Certificate validity dates reject the connection.
rules.strategy: Check test host clock; server operator must replace expired certificate.

rules.cause: Converter does not have a verified semantic mapping.
rules.strategy: Keep original and classify untested; implement mapping from pinned source plus fixtures.
Keep original; no silent field removal.
Do not classify the config as broken; add a pinned-source protocol driver.

rules.cause: No expected HTTPS result within the test deadline.
rules.strategy: Bounded retest with independent destinations; do not guess passwords, keys or server ports.

rules.cause: Two HTTPS destinations passed through isolated proxy runtime.
rules.strategy: Record original/candidate/runtime hashes, target, environment and expiry; Android remains not_run.

rules.cause: Pinned Hysteria outbound accepts version 2 only; the pinned Android URI registry has no Hysteria 1 parser.
rules.strategy: Retain original and report target incompatibility; do not relabel Hysteria 1 as Hy2.

rules.cause: Unknown Amnezia/noise or other settings do not have a verified mapping.
rules.strategy: Retain the original. Standard WireGuard URI/INI maps keys, multiple peers, IPv6 endpoints, keepalive, reserved, addresses and DNS separately into custom JSON.
